title: Old calls asked again with thinking on; only a replay that gives the same answer explains the original
request: The owner: 'make sure all previous data has thinking and reasoning parts, it's crucial'; a $45 budget for the backfill. 237 kept calls had their whole inputs but no thinking text.
spec: Re-send each replayable call's original messages and tools (from the workspace's own files, never the shaped copies), thinking on, within one cap; keep each answer beside the original's id, split and consent; keep its thinking for the original only when the answer agrees (the same reply and tool calls); label it replayed, weight 0.5, never recorded; never re-ask sealed or exam calls; never keep the replay's own call as a second conversation.
plan: backfill.replay and backfill.replays; the --replay command with a cap.
llm.from_exchange takes an agreeing replay as replayed (silver).
Tests with a scripted model; then the paid run.

decisions.decision: Only an agreeing replay's thinking is kept for the original.
decisions.why: Thinking that led to a different answer does not explain the original answer; keeping it would teach a reason for an answer it did not give.

decisions.decision: The replay's own call keeps its shape only.
decisions.why: Otherwise the same inputs would enter training twice, once as recorded.
It is the model's thinking, but made later, on a possibly different model version: never the original's own.

change: dclab_rnd/store/backfill.py (originals, replay, replays); store/__main__.py (--replay); store/sets/llm.py (replayed); dclab_core/store.py (ReasoningSource 'replayed'); tests/test_store_backfill.py.

findings.defect: Agreement was judged by exact match, so almost no replay counted as the same answer.
findings.scenario: The first 5 replays: 0 agreed, though the replies had the same tool calls and nearly the same words.
findings.cause: Exact text equality between a reply and its replay; model replies vary in wording.
findings.fix: same_decision: same tool calls, close arguments, close reply; replays() judges agreement again on read.

findings.defect: 3 replays failed with RuntimeError and were skipped; the run went on.
findings.scenario: Three calls of 216 raised RuntimeError in the gateway; they have no replay row.
findings.fix: None yet: they stay unreplayed and can be retried by the same command.

measurements.name: Paid replay of the kept calls without thinking
measurements.result: 216 calls sent of 221 planned (9 already done, 6 without originals); 80 agreed (37%); spent $1.593 of the cap; 3 RuntimeErrors.

outcome: 80 of 216 replayed calls gave the same decision and carry replayed thinking (weight 0.5); the other 136 disagreed and keep their shape only, so their thinking is not attached to the original answer.
lessons: A reason is only a reason for the answer it led to: check the answer before keeping the reasoning.
risks: The model asked today may differ from the one asked then; the label and the weight say so.
63% of replays disagreed: most old calls still lack thinking; the next source is a checked teacher (C5), capped.
